# HealMent

> HealMent is a free journaling app for iPhone and Android that helps people look after their mental health. It offers 200+ guided prompts, your own custom prompts, mood tracking, an insight dashboard, bookmarks and dark and light themes. Journal entries stay on the user's phone.

## Pages

- [Home](https://healment.cend.in/): what the app does, features and download links
- [Contact](https://healment.cend.in/contact.html): how to get help or share feedback
- [Privacy Policy](https://healment.cend.in/privacy_policy.html): how information is handled
- [Terms of Service](https://healment.cend.in/terms_of_service.html): rules for using the app and website

## Download
